description: Checks a public website with Sitecomb. It returns a website quality review: the areas that have problems, with a count for each, and an overall score out of 100. It does not name the problems: those are in the full quality report. Use it when someone asks whether their website is any good, or what is wrong with it. Also use it when someone asks why their website isn't working for them, or asks to check or audit a website. It looks at six areas: Security, Privacy & legal, Page health, Phone friendly, Contact details and Online visibility. A check loads the site the way a visitor's browser does and takes up to about a minute. It only finds problems; it never changes anything on the site. If the site is down or blocks automatic checks, it says it couldn't check and gives no score. Checks are limited per person and per website each day.

url.description: The website address to check, for example https://yoursite.com or yoursite.com.

name: check_website
title: Check a website
